notes: family: point-salad-euro. Points are tracked on the scoring track as ships finish their shakedown cruise; enter track value before the end-of-game contract reveal. Contract values depend on the contract tile in play (tables like 1-2-4-6-8-12 for lifebuoys/lanterns/lifeboats, 3 pts per pair, etc.) so they are entered as totals. Solo game uses 2 contracts and score bands (60/80/95+) and is not modelled.
